Hero.title: Intelligence, precision, and compliance on every kilometer
Hero.description: We are a team of engineers specialized in road auditing, geometric validation, and signage. We process your Civil 3D model and deliver technical reports with findings, V85 speed analysis, and signage under INVIAS, MTC, and MOP regulations.

Metodologia.mainTitle: What we do and how we do it
Metodologia.mainSubtitle: It is not standard software. It is a proprietary methodology that automates processes no CAD software solves — with technical deliverables backed by official standards.
Metodologia.card1Title: Geometric analysis directly from your Civil 3D model
Metodologia.card1Desc: Our clients provide us with the LandXML exported directly from Civil 3D. From that file, we apply a specialized workflow to process horizontal alignments, longitudinal profiles, superelevations, and cross sections — without requiring the client to prepare additional files or master the analysis methodology.
Metodologia.card1Detail: The result is a comprehensive technical audit backed by official standards, with deliverables ready for supervision and decision-making.
card1Items: Complete regulatory checklist — minimum radii, superelevations, widenings, and transition lengths evaluated against INVIAS, MTC, or MOP
V85 operating speed — calculated segment by segment using Lamm's Method (1999), identifying where geometry exceeds actual driver speed
HV Findings — simultaneous overlay of horizontal and vertical non-compliances at the same station point
Importable CSV back into Civil 3D with georeferenced inventory and regulatory justification per element
Metodologia.card2Desc: V85 is the speed that 85% of drivers do not exceed under free-flow conditions. It is the core parameter to evaluate whether road geometry aligns with actual driver behavior.
Metodologia.card2Detail: No CAD software —Civil 3D, AutoCAD, or BIM platforms— calculates V85 automatically. It requires applying Lamm's model (1999) segment by segment. Our workflow automates this, providing actual V85 per segment with regulatory justification.
card2Items: Automatic segment-by-segment calculation using Lamm's Method (1999)
Identification of critical segments based on V85 differentials
Compatible with INVIAS (Colombia), MTC (Peru), and MOP (Chile)
Metodologia.card3Title: HV Audit — Simultaneous Horizontal and Vertical Sight Distance
Metodologia.card3Desc: An HV finding occurs when a road section has sight distance restrictions in both plan (horizontal) and profile (vertical) at the exact same location. This is the most critical condition for road safety.
Metodologia.card3Detail: Most audits evaluate H and V separately. Our methodology detects the simultaneous overlap of both restrictions, uncovering true blind spots invisible in individual analyses. This gives supervisors clear technical justification for corrective actions.
card3Items: Detection of H and V restrictions at the same station point
Report with georeferenced HV findings and corrective signage plans
Metodologia.card4Title: What the client receives — Comprehensive technical report
Metodologia.card4Desc: Every project generates a structured package of deliverables ranging from geometric findings to signage inventory, backed by official standards and ready for supervision, bidding, or engineering decisions.
Metodologia.card4Detail: We don't just deliver a PDF. The client receives a full QA/QC report with all findings categorized by severity, alongside a georeferenced database ready for GIS or direct Civil 3D import.
card4Items: QA/QC report with geometric findings categorized by risk level (critical, high, medium)
Regulatory checklist per horizontal and vertical curve with documented compliance
Georeferenced HV findings with intervention recommendations and corrective signage
V85 operating speed per segment with critical section identification
Vertical signage inventory with station, side, sign code, and regulatory justification
Ortho-photo plans, importable CSV for Civil 3D, and executive summary for supervisors

Features.mainTitle: Advanced Tools for Road Safety and Geometric Analysis
Features.mainParagraph: Technical automation focused on road safety audits, geometric validation, road signage, and operational assessment under Latin American standards.
Features.feature1_desc: We identify hidden risks in highways, roundabouts, and intersections using advanced technical audits based on operating speed, sight distance, geometry, and regulatory compliance.
Features.feature2_desc: Smart validation of radii, superelevation, widening, crown slopes, spirals, plan-profile coordination, and sight distances under official road regulations.
Features.feature3_desc: We detect critical inconsistencies in vertical and horizontal signage, validating placement, regulatory coherence, visibility, and real necessity based on operational behavior.
Features.feature4_desc: Compatible with official standards from Colombia (INVÍAS), Peru (MTC), and Chile (MOP), enabling road audits tailored to each country's technical guidelines.
Features.feature5_desc: We evaluate deflection, entry speed, critical vehicle swept paths, potential conflicts, and operational safety in urban and rural roundabouts.
Features.feature6_desc: We significantly reduce technical review times through automated analysis of road geometry, V85 speeds, signage, safety compliance, and critical findings.
Features.brochure1Desc: V85 methodology, high-risk audit workflow, service packages, and real-world case studies — 5 pages.
Features.brochure2Desc: Full portfolio covering geometric design, technical automation, and engineering services — 13 pages.

Footer.description: Smart road auditing based on geometric analysis, V85 operating speed, and official technical standards from Colombia, Peru, and Chile.
